Shobhit Bhansali (under the brand name Phelix Capital) facilitates investments in mutual fund schemes offered by various Asset Management Companies ("AMCs").
Shobhit Bhansali or Phelix Capital receives commissions and/or trail commissions from Asset Management Companies for distributing mutual fund schemes.
Such commissions are paid by the respective AMCs and are generally built into the total expense ratio (TER) of the mutual fund scheme in accordance with applicable regulations.
Investors do not pay any separate distribution fee directly to Shobhit Bhansali or Phelix Capital unless specifically disclosed otherwise.
Compensation received by Shobhit Bhansali or Phelix Capital may include:
Upfront commissions (if permitted under applicable regulations);
Incentives, reimbursements, or support programs offered by AMCs in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

However, investors should be aware that commissions may vary between schemes and AMCs.
